extracted.subtask_short: retrieve case law via BNA IP
extracted.subtask_description: Step-by-step procedure for locating and retrieving case law (USPQ/West citations) using the Bloomberg BNA Intellectual Property Law Resource Center search page (accessible via Examiner tools or PTOWeb). Includes specific navigation paths and citation-search instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Navigate to the BNA IP Search Page
rubrics_metrics.description: Bloomberg BNA is the publisher of the United States Patent Quarterly. Examiners have desktop access to the Bloomberg BNA Intellectual Property Law Resource Center search page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ways to reach the BNA IP Search Page: Click the USPQ link in the Examiner’s Tool Kit; Click START on the lower left of your monitor and enter USPQ in the search box; Go directly to http://iplaw.bna.com/iplw/; Or navigate via PTOWeb: from the PTOWeb home page click “Resources”, click “STIC (Scientific and Technical Information Center)”, click “Legal e‐Library”, then click “USPQ (U.S. Patents Quarterly).”

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for the case on the BNA IP Search Page
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter either the West reporter citation or the USPQ citation in the citation search box, then click GO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: to retrieve KSR v. Teleflex, enter either 550 U.S. 398 or 82 USPQ2d 1385 in the citation search box and click GO. For additional operational details about using the BNA IP Search Page, consult an ITRP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consult training materials / ITRP if needed
rubrics_metrics.description: For more information or further instruction on using the BNA IP Search Page and understanding case-law retrieval, consult internal training resources or an ITRP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: The information on this QRS is excerpted from slides 31 and 32 of the training module titled “Responding to Legal Arguments Part I: Understanding Case Law and the Federal Court System”, which is posted on http://ptoweb.uspto.gov/patents/exTrain/responding-to-legal-arguments.html. Contact an ITRP for hands-on assistance.
